strategy_scope: 体系3.6/实现模块E的供应商宽度序列研究代理；不修改原E、阈值、原文或生产

admissibility.original_E: blocked: historical membership and price/algorithm definition unqualified
admissibility.historically_available_prediction: blocked: historical release/revision availability unqualified; current file generated after most or all labels
admissibility.saved_series_retrospective_association: allowed: named immutable provider percentages are themselves an observable object; unknown construction limits interpretation, not arithmetic comparison
admissibility.independent_validation_C: not_computed: previously seen SPY history, same research family, revised provider vintage; chronological split does not change this
admissibility.extreme_state_models: describe_only: four dual-low dates in one April 2025 episode and no dual-high dates

four_controller_reasons.object: SPY is the bounded US broad-market ETF outcome; current provider-labelled SP500 percentage is the studied input, not certified historical SP500 breadth. No China/global/sector transfer.
four_controller_reasons.proxy: B20 preserves the short moving-average participation idea, but omits B50 confirmation, historical membership fidelity, confirmations/entry/exit. Continuous B20 is a separate research proxy, never original E validation.
four_controller_reasons.method_support: Controller date-only support is 175 common training rows and 147 evaluation rows after delta20 warmup, versus 195 training without warmup. Five tiny models have at most four parameters. Twenty-interval overlap means only a short run of market environments; restricted exploratory arithmetic is defensible, stable generalization or precise inference is not.
four_controller_reasons.inference: Report representation/model-specific retrospective error differences and raw later-price distributions. Even a favorable difference cannot establish real-time availability, unique information beyond all price state, profitable policy or causal effects.

primary_question: For this frozen saved provider B20 series, does including its continuous value reduce retrospective 2026 SPY 20-interval return-estimation error beyond the preceding 20-interval SPY return?

definition.X: local:sentiment.provider-b20-continuous@1.0.0 = saved ma20 percentage_above, percentage points; do not reconstruct from current members or numerator
definition.t: provider date must match an actual SPY quote date exactly; unmatched dates excluded explicitly, never rolled or filled
definition.price: frozen existing SPY adjustedClose vintage only, all quote rows retained; do not compress across missing/invalid required prices
definition.label: twenty return intervals, twenty-one closes from next actual quote close through twenty quotes later; complete positive finite closes required
definition.background: requires full twenty-one close sequence t-20..t; only data through t enter B
definition.time_semantics: provider labels are retrospective observation anchors, not known publication timestamps. Next close is a comparison convention, not a claimed implementable delay.
definition.unit_and_weight: one source date, one SPY target, equal weight per common eligible date
definition.D: local:sentiment.provider-b20-change20@1.0.0 = B20[t]-B20[t-20], percentage points; t-20 refers to original SPY quote calendar, not compressed matched-provider rows; require all B20 values at original quote dates t-20..t, no filling. Separate research proxy; original S02 equivalence not asserted.

estimation.training: eligible observation date before 2026-01-01 AND complete target endpoint strictly before 2026-01-01
estimation.evaluation: eligible observation date on/after 2026-01-01 with complete target inside available frozen price history; freeze the exact resulting last date before values are evaluated
estimation.fit_schedule: one fit per model; no annual refit in 2025, random split, alternate boundary or tuning
estimation.model: standardize slopes with training mean/population SD; fixed ridge lambda 0.001 minimizing mean squared error plus lambda times squared slopes, unpenalized intercept; I arithmetic training target mean
estimation.primary: 100*(1-MSE_BX/MSE_B) on same evaluation dates; also absolute paired squared-error difference in squared percentage points
estimation.mandatory_comparators: show I, B, X, BX, BXD MSE and root MSE on common rows; prominently disclose if B/BX/BXD is worse than I; X alone does not establish increment
estimation.support_record_before_fits: source dates, matched quote dates, valid inputs, mature labels, boundary exclusions, common train/evaluation, fixed quarter counts, overlapping target spans, and training/evaluation feature ranges; no unsupported effective-sample-number claim
estimation.common_support: All five models use identical delta20-complete population: controller date-only counts 175 train and 147 evaluation. Do not compare expanded model against baseline trained on 195 dates.
estimation.secondary: 100*(1-MSE_BXD/MSE_BX), with paired absolute squared-error difference and same uncertainty procedure; explicitly secondary and subject to same source/selection limits.

descriptive_evidence.population: all mature common dates, reported separately from 2026 evaluation dates
descriptive_evidence.groups: original dual-low B20<=15 AND B50<=15; original dual-high B20>=85 AND B50>=85; neither. No new threshold or quantile search.
descriptive_evidence.columns: source count, mature count, first/last date, contiguous runs plus explanation that April runs share one market episode, mean/median 20-interval change, positive proportion, mean/median future maximum peak-to-trough loss
descriptive_evidence.downside: 100*max over j of [1-C[j]/max(C[t+1..j])] for j=t+1..t+21; distinct from loss relative to first price; no fitted risk model
descriptive_evidence.limitations: four low dates are cases, not four independent reversals; no high dates means not evaluated, never zero return or ineffectiveness. Full-period description is not the fitted evaluation population.

uncertainty.method: paired noncircular contiguous moving-block resampling of fixed 2026 evaluation prediction rows; models travel together; 2000 draws
uncertainty.outputs: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of paired loss difference and MSE-ratio improvement when denominator positive
uncertainty.qualification: conditional descriptive ranges only: short evaluation series has few long blocks; does not include source construction, revisions, model fitting or research-family selection uncertainty. Do not turn interval exclusion of zero into certification. If insufficient eligible blocks, mark interval insufficient without reducing length.

necessary_counterexamples: Report fixed calendar-quarter evaluation results (2026 Q1/Q2/Q3 partial as available), and delete each available quarter from saved predictions without refitting; report unsupported quarters separately.

Report same-model errors within prior-20-return negative/nonnegative backgrounds and largest five individual dates' paired-error contributions; these are descriptions, not new fitted models or independently sampled dates.

Repeat the five fixed model fits after removing training rows whose entire target interval intersects 2025-04-01..2025-04-30. Evaluate on exactly the original 2026 dates. This deliberately tests dependence on the one known low-breadth market episode, not whether another cutoff works. Recompute scaling only on the retained training rows for each sensitivity fit; never scale on evaluation rows. Record how much training coverage is removed; constant feature or inadequate remaining calendar support means this check is insufficient, not permission to move the cutoff.

Carry forward old/current version audit: 186 shared dates, B20 185 changed, B50/B200 all changed; maxima 1.90/1.67/1.68 percentage points, unchanged four low dates. Neither unchanged low classification nor small numerical revisions prove original validity. No version-outcome scan required to answer this bounded object-specific question.
verification: Independent recomputation of three exact label endpoints, raw group denominators, core loss totals/differences from saved predictions, and independent linear solve/scaling check. Include synthetic missing-day/invalid-price/boundary/constant-feature cases before real fitting. Numerical mismatch is a correction attempt under existing budget, never silent replacement.
stops: Input or frozen protocol hash drift; mismatched common evaluation rows; time endpoints invalid; nonfinite model results; budget limit.
No switch to 120-day horizon, B50/B200 outcome models, thresholds, years or universes after seeing results.
Complete this bounded question after core comparison, necessary counterexamples and numerical reconciliation; favorable, unfavorable or uncertain outcomes all may close it.

If source qualification prevents original E or historical live prediction, close those uses as evidence boundaries while completing the allowed saved-series association. Do not claim the factor family or original E completed.
required_parent_actions_before_compute: Bind actual strategy-document hashes and exact original quotation/sections from controller's existing reading; this review relied on delegated mapping and did not inspect desktop documents.
Freeze concrete protocol and complete date-only training/evaluation support artifact; acknowledge all prior family trials and previously seen SPY cache.
Record fit/batch use cumulatively within controller's existing budget; technical workflow sentiment guard is not a scientific rejection and must not be bypassed by relabelling as technical factor.

date_only_support_supplied_by_controller.qualification: Controller reports reading only Date, no outcome values; concrete protocol must bind saved date-only qualification artifact.

secondary_question: Does the predeclared 20-quote-interval change in saved B20 reduce retrospective error beyond r20 plus current B20? One secondary contrast, no promotion to primary if primary is unfavorable.
amendment_before_outcomes: Controller requested one predeclared S02-related delta20 contrast before any provider outcome values or fits; admitted only as subordinate research proxy, same common population, no extra horizon or threshold.
